steps.description:
Write a program that call a function to do the following: 1. Draw a box 400 pixels wide by 200 pixels high with its center at (0, 0). 2. Set the pen shape to "turtle" and place it at (0, 0). 3. Set the pen speed to 3. 4. Using infinite loop, move the turtle in the following manner: a. move forward 20 pixels. The turtle should draw as it moves. b. If the turtle went out of the box, move backward 20 pixels so that it returns to its previous position and turn left with a random value from -140 to 140.

Hint: - Recall Cartesian collision in earlier question.

Write a program that call a function to do the following: 1. Draw a box 400 pixels wide by 200 pixels high with its center at (0, 0). Use "white" outline for the box and fill it with "yellow". 2. Ask the user to input a point (x, y) where x and y is between 0 to 200. Draw a square with length 100 centered at (x, y). Use "white" outline and fill it with "white". 3. Set the pen shape to "turtle" and place it at (-150, 0). Set the pen speed to 3 and colour to "green". 4. Using infinite loop, move the turtle in the following manner: a. move forward 20 pixel. The turtle should draw as it moves. b. move backward 20 pixel and turn left with a random value from -140 to 140 when necessary to keep the turtle within the yellow region. Note that it must not cross the boundaries. Hint: - Recall the concept in Castle collision question - Leaving a border of 20 pixels can avoid the turtle from crossing the lines.
